label: Nov 27, 2026 (evening)
title: LinkedIn Digest — Nov 27, 2026 (PM)
source: Tableau Data Apps keep rolling in (Kirk Munroe, Tobiloba Babajide, Matt Meier), plus Anh Leimer's Claude-driven Power BI standardization and several polished dashboards.

items.author: Kirk Munroe, Nov 27, 1h ago
items.summary: Rebuilt his old Iron Viz Feeder entry, "Every Iron Maiden Show", as a Tableau Data App in about 90 minutes, including the scripts to fetch the data. 7 reactions, 1 comment, 1 repost.

items.author: Tobiloba Babajide, Nov 27, 4h ago
items.summary: His first published Tableau Data App: rebuilds a MakeoverMonday NYC park squirrel-sightings viz as side-by-side map panels after the November Cloud/Server release, with a short "what is a Data App" explainer. 11 reactions, 2 comments.

items.author: Matt Meier, Nov 27, 4h ago
items.summary: Five TidyTuesday vizzes built alongside his Data Apps testing, led by a Pope Leo XIV vs Rerum Novarum word-share chart; links to Sustainable Energy for All and European Parenting Leave Policies vizzes. 1 reaction.

items.author: Lisa Hitch, MPH, Nov 27, 5h ago
items.summary: "Context is the key" Tableau Studio test: the same IPV dataset prompted three ways (topic only; plus user and decision; plus layout and palette) goes from a generic overview to a polished dashboard. 5 reactions.

items.author: Levi Leite, Nov 26, 23h ago
items.summary: Migration angle: Snowflake's CoCo agent now has a skill that takes a Tableau .twb/.twbx and converts it, aimed at the legacy-workbook pain in every BI migration. 2 reactions.

items.author: Anh Leimer, Nov 27, 6h ago
items.summary: Uses Claude to standardize 50+ Power BI reports: build a template, turn it into a critical/warning checklist, save reports as PBIP (TMDL/PBIR text), and have Claude audit and fix them in batches. Shows a clean IBCS-style net sales report. 52 reactions, 4 comments, 6 reposts.

items.author: Shane Butler, Nov 27, 4h ago
items.summary: "If your value is making the next report someone asked for, you're going to have a problem": argues report and dashboard building is being commoditized by AI, with a chart of software built with AI by role and purpose. Counts not captured.

items.author: Faizaan Fareed, Nov 27, 13h ago
items.summary: Case on hitting 86% of the sales target but only 79% of cash collected, with a polished "Who is carrying the target" dashboard (salesperson scorecards, cumulative sales vs target, product-group matrix) for a fictional company. 20 reactions, 7 comments, 1 repost.

items.author: Andy Kriebel, Nov 27, 7h ago
items.summary: 17-page carousel tutorial: how to build an enclosed dot plot in Tableau. 9 reactions.

items.author: Andy Kriebel, Nov 26, 1d ago
items.summary: Mobile drill-down with Dynamic Zone Visibility, shown as a "Superstore Pulse" phone mockup with collapsible Sales, Profit and Customers sections. 16 reactions, 2 comments.

items.author: Matt Meier, Nov 26, 1d ago
items.summary: Back 2 Viz Basics week 21: polished dark "Ballon d'Or Historical Podiums 1956–2026" Tableau dashboard with an action filter. 2 reactions.

items.author: King Joseph, Nov 23, 4d ago
items.summary: Dense dark Power BI "UK & Global Health System Performance 2018–2024" dashboard (map, KPI cards, anomaly tags, recovery lines); takeaway: ICU occupancy ended 2024 at 72.2% vs 72.3% pre-pandemic. 14 reactions, 2 reposts.

items.author: Jobgether
items.summary: Director, Finance Data, Reporting & AI — Jobgether (for an unnamed partner company) — United States (Remote) — posted Nov 27, 2026 — Salary not listed. Leads Finance data, reporting, analytics and AI: certified single source of truth, governance and SOX controls, Finance AI agents on certified data; 10+ years Finance data/BI plus 3+ years people management; SQL, Databricks, NetSuite, Salesforce, Pigment, Power BI/Tableau/Workiva.
